name: spotify
title: Spotify
summary: Search, tracks, artists, the current user, currently playing and playlist edits on api.spotify.com, plus the accounts.spotify.com token endpoint, with expired-token, nothing-playing, not-found, rate-limit and outage scenarios.

upstream.notes: Spotify's OpenAPI file has no licence and falls under the Spotify Developer Terms. sonallux/spotify-web-api republishes a fixed copy in an MIT-licensed repository, but the definition itself is Spotify's, so it is not pinned. The contract keeps Spotify's operation ids.
